## History

William Blair operates a local store where [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempts to shop for a fashionable dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Following Matthew's awkward interaction at the establishment, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to seek Mrs. Rachel Lynde's assistance instead to obtain the garment.
